grpc.resolution: Git tag plus recursive upstream submodule gitlinks; capture resolved commit IDs in build-manifest.json
grpc.source_build_alternative: Optional FetchContent lane only; not evidence for the package lane. Previous all-target source build exceeded the 45-minute job budget.

protobuf.resolution: Use the submodule commit fixed by the gRPC source tree to keep protoc and C++ runtime aligned; capture its resolved commit ID

dependencies.version_policy: Initial Linux run captures observed distribution package versions. Freeze exact resolved versions in this lock and CI before validating repeatability.

validation.reason: Packaged dependency lane selected after source build timeout. Pending generated-contract compilation, tests and observed environment manifest.

limitations: The ubuntu-24.04 hosted runner image is a mutable label; workflow records ImageOS/ImageVersion and OS package versions instead of inventing an image digest.
The gRPC release tag is fixed, and recursive submodules resolve to fixed gitlink revisions; exact commit IDs are recorded from the actual checkout before promoting this candidate lock.
The contract lane validates Ubuntu's matched compiler/runtime packages; it does not imply the optional source dependency lane or Linux enforcement topology is verified.
